description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and two metrics—“Perplexity” on the left y-axis and “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” on the right y-axis—for four different conditions represented by distinct lines. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, ranges from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The left y-axis, labeled “Perplexity”, ranges from 4.2 to 4.7, and the right y-axis, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, ranges from 40 to 100. The orange line with circle markers, labeled “Perplexity”, starts at approximately 4.6 at 20% and declines to about 4.3 at 60%, before rising slightly to around 4.4 at 100%. The blue line with circle markers, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio”, begins at approximately 42% at 20% and increases sharply to nearly 100% at 100%. The red dashed line, labeled “Full Cache PPL”, is a horizontal reference line at approximately 4.4. The blue dashed line, labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, is a horizontal reference line at 100%.
